qAndA.question: What type of telescope did Nico use for observing the planets?

qAndA.answer: Because the wooden deck was shaking every time he moved, creating too much vibration for the telescope.
qAndA.question: Why was Nico having trouble observing planets from his balcony?

qAndA.answer: A crop mode on his DSLR that records video from a small area in the center of the sensor.
qAndA.question: What camera mode did Nico choose to record his video?

qAndA.answer: To center the planet in each frame of the video before stacking.
qAndA.question: Why did Nico use PIPP software before AutoStakkert?

qAndA.answer: Wavelet processing to sharpen details and noise reduction to smooth out the image.

youtube_description:
A little adventure in planetary imaging from a less than ideal location! If you enjoyed this video, consider joining me and 497 other astrophotographers on Patreon: https://patreon.com/nebulaphotos Starting at just $1/month you will get access to exclusive videos, monthly zoom chats, monthly imaging challenges, a vibrant discord community, and collaborative imaging projects.

Free software used in this video:
PIPP: https://web.archive.org/web/20230531163522/https://sites.google.com/site/astropipp/downloads 
AutoStakkert!: https://www.autostakkert.com/
Registax: https://www.astronomie.be/registax/

Video files I captured from the deck:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OxCQLMGllqdEC8i0-THdmCLidK39NEQX?usp=sharing

Gear used in this video:
Canon 60D 
Sky-watcher Flextube 250P: https://tinyurl.com/flextube250
Televue Powermate 2.5x: https://tinyurl.com/powermate2p5
